summary: This video breaks down top-ranking team compositions and hero builds from the final week of Continental Challenge in the Season 9 Chinese server. Gorax analyzes six specific boss matchups (Rose, Quaesitia, Stegamoffyn, Beldelle, Synarell, and Guinavivre) covering damage outputs, artifact choices, stat priorities, and skill rotation timings. Notable highlights include a 3.2 billion damage Radiant team utilizing Holfast and Talethia, as well as a 2.14 billion Dauntless squad. The guide also reveals that many top setups function effectively even with low-inspiration or Inspiration 0 heroes.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Excels against multi-target boss Rose; build full Crit Rate and Crit Damage without worrying about Attack.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Significantly boosts teamwide damage for Talethia, making her easier to build than when paired with Lincos.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Reached 3.2 billion damage against Beldelle when supported by Holfast, built with 100% Crit Rate, high Crit Damage, and HP.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Skip Crit Damage runes entirely and prioritize maximum Crit Rate and Attack.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Enables strict 15-second skill rotations via Skill Haste and debuffs, especially useful for new players.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Functions exceptionally well even at Inspiration 0 to enable 15-second rotation bursts.

heroes.name: Arlow
heroes.note: Reflects boss debuffs and requires high Skill Haste (around 58+) to maintain team rotations.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Can be built with high DPS stats in Corrosion teams or as a massive 90k+ HP primary tank in single-target fights.

teams.note: AoE Corrosion team designed to melt multiple target bodies; utilizes default rotation timings with Child of Chaos on a 15-second cycle.
Frost team dealing ~298M damage; Olgan boosts attack via ultimate while Arlow cleanses and reflects boss debuffs.
High-investment Dauntless composition dealing over 2.14B damage; requires around 175-200 Effect Resistance across heroes.
Ice Blast team alternative dealing 1.16B to 1.61B damage; run Celestine on default rotation.
Insane 3.2B damage Radiant/Aura team operating on synchronized 15-second rotation cycles.
Thunderbolt team timed to a 15-second rotation; Journ provides high Haste to prevent skill desynchronization.
Single-target Poison/Serpentemis composition dealing 800M-1.13B damage using Sacredeia or a frontline melee tank to absorb hits.

meta_changes: Holfast at Inspiration 2 has overtaken older Aura buffers like Lincos to create record-shattering 3.2B+ damage bursts with Talethia.
Strict 15-second skill rotation tuning driven by specific Haste thresholds and heroes like Journ and Rena dominates high-end boss clears.
Many top CN teams succeed with low-inspiration or Inspiration 0 heroes (such as Rena, Arlow, and Child of Chaos), lowering inspiration dependency.
tips: When building Beldelle, skip Crit Damage runes completely and focus purely on Attack and Crit Rate.
Against Stegamoffyn, stack at least 175 to 200 Effect Resistance on your debuff cleansers and supports to survive boss mechanics.
For strict 15-second rotation teams (such as Thunderbolt or Radiant), match your Skill Haste thresholds carefully so heroes trigger skills in precise sync.
If you lack Inspiration on Holfast, Diantha can act as an effective secondary DPS to maintain solid Aura team output.
